home.description: I've been building systems since 2022, focusing on scalable architectures and using Generative AI to make engineering faster and more reliable.

about.summary: I currently work as a Cross Tech Lead at Mutant, allocated to Telefônica Vivo, supporting multiple squads on financial journeys and digital services to ensure technical excellence, resilience, and architectural evolution.
about.summary2: My engineering practice is driven by Clean Code, TDD, and agile culture. I constantly seek to optimize the development cycle by integrating modern AI tools, like Codeium, promoting efficient deliveries and sustainable architectures.

bio.description: My journey began in Production Engineering (UNIVESP) and, over the years, I dove deep into software development. I hold a postgraduate degree in Web Development (IF Sul de Minas) and am now pursuing a second one, in Information Technologies and Systems (UFABC). I am deeply interested in solving complex problems, structuring everything from robust cloud architectures to innovative AI integrations, always focusing on generating real business impact.

mutantLead.description: I work hands-on supporting multiple agile squads in the Vivo app ecosystem. My role combines active development, architecture definition, and the use of GenAI in the engineering cycle.
mutantLead.activity1: Technical leadership in critical financial journeys, such as Automatic Invoice Payment, Automatic PIX, and Automatic Debit.
mutantLead.activity2: Design of scalable architectures in microservices, BFFs, and MFEs using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and React.
mutantLead.activity3: Dissemination of technical culture (Clean Code, TDD) through constructive code reviews and internal mentoring.
mutantLead.activity4: Integration of AI-assisted development and DevSecOps best practices into the team's routine.

mutantFs.description: Development and improvement of journeys in the Vivo App, delivering solutions for millions of customers with a focus on performance and stability.
mutantFs.activity1: Built complex workflows in journeys such as Smart Home, Technical Support, Vivo Travel, and e-SIM.
mutantFs.activity2: Worked with microservices architecture and integration of legacy systems in cloud environments (Azure/Kubernetes).
mutantFs.activity3: Intense application of unit testing (Jest), mutation testing (Stryker), and E2E (Cypress) to ensure code resilience.

marttech.description: Development of the Curar Saúde platform, an education and engagement solution focused on usability and interactivity.
marttech.activity1: Created responsive interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Material UI based on Figma prototypes.
marttech.activity2: Planned, distributed technical tasks, and assisted in leveling up junior developers.
marttech.activity3: Configured CI/CD pipelines and continuous deployment workflows in Azure DevOps.

xmart.description: Full Stack development of the xGuardian security application, prioritizing clean architecture and high performance.
xmart.activity1: Implemented the backend via Python and FastAPI in the BFF pattern, integrating MySQL/MariaDB databases.
xmart.activity2: Created frontend interfaces using React, Tailwind, and Shadcn/ui components.
xmart.activity3: Refactored code and structured projects under Clean Architecture principles and security testing (Dast/Sast).

vtal.description: Maintenance, innovation, and modernization of strategic telecommunication portals and systems.
vtal.activity1: Developed the Access Management module (React/NestJS) and Technical Support for carriers (React/Spring Boot).
vtal.activity2: Structured a static Developer Portal for API documentation, integrating a focus on Developer Experience (DX).
vtal.activity3: Fixed bugs and sustained mission-critical legacy systems connected to OracleDB.

gama.description: Intensive agile immersion program. I worked for 45 days developing a digital product that won 1st place in the Gama-lab hackathon.
gama.activity1: Built the API for a robust Learning Management System (LMS) using NestJS, TypeORM, and PostgreSQL.
gama.activity2: Applied Scrum methodology, Gitflow versioning, and standardization with Conventional Commits.

metro.description: Support for maintenance engineering operations with a focus on data analysis and continuous process improvement at Metrô de São Paulo.
metro.activity1: Created management dashboards and processed operational data with Power BI and Excel.
metro.activity2: Provided analytical support for SAP ERP implementation and executed time-and-motion studies.
